creatives.headline: First Ad In 5 Days
creatives.scene: Zam energized and genuinely excited — bright open smile, leaning slightly forward toward camera, one hand mid-gesture; slight LOW camera angle for momentum and authority; bright confident gold glow behind her
creatives.prompt:
Photorealistic premium social-media advertisement, vertical 4:5 format.
Follow the Grifon design system (DESIGN.md) — ad creatives are a governed marketing surface.

BRAND SYSTEM (keep identical across every creative):
- Canvas background: deep near-black charcoal #09090B (zinc-950). NEVER pure black #000000 — it reads flat; zinc-950 retains cinematic atmosphere.
- A dramatic Grifon-Gold #FFCC00 radial glow emanating from directly behind the subject, fading into the dark canvas. Gold #FFCC00 is the SINGLE accent hue in the whole image.
- Any panel / badge / chip fill: elevated charcoal #18181B (zinc-900).
- Subject: the confident person from the provided reference image, upper body, CENTERED, polished and authoritative. Keep their FACIAL IDENTITY faithful to the reference — but the reference is an IDENTITY ANCHOR, not a pose lock: ADAPT their expression, pose, gesture, and the camera angle/crop to match this creative's mood (described in Scene). Do not copy the reference's exact pose or framing.
- Wardrobe: a tailored charcoal / near-black blazer (zinc-900) over a clean neutral top — do NOT reproduce off-brand clothing colors from the reference photo. Keep wardrobe on-brand (dark, premium); gold may appear only as a small accent.
- Top lockup: a bold gold #FFCC00 "GRIFON AI" wordmark, clean modern sans, centered at the top. NO "VIP" badge, no membership mark, no extra tags beside it.
- Call-to-action: a fully-rounded gold pill button (#FFCC00 fill, BLACK #000000 text), horizontally CENTERED near the bottom, reading "Try It Free".

THIS CREATIVE'S VARIATION:
- Scene / mood (incl. facial expression + camera angle): Zam energized and genuinely excited — bright open smile, leaning slightly forward toward camera, one hand mid-gesture; slight LOW camera angle for momentum and authority; bright confident gold glow behind her
- Badge / eyebrow label (centered): START FREE
- Headline — render this exact text, large and perfectly spelled, 3-7 words, high contrast, CENTER-ALIGNED, do NOT overlap the subject's face:
  "First Ad In 5 Days"

LAYOUT: badge, headline, and CTA are all horizontally CENTER-aligned, stacked as a centered column. Symmetrical, professional, balanced.

TYPOGRAPHY (DESIGN.md):
- Headline font: Inter / Geist / SF Pro — clean geometric sans, weight 700 (bold), tight letter-spacing. White text, with at most ONE or TWO accent words in Grifon-Gold #FFCC00.
- Optional flourish: render 1-2 of the gold accent words in an elegant italic serif (Instrument Serif style) for an editorial premium feel — keep the rest bold sans.

STYLE: Hollywood-grade studio lighting, sharp focus, glossy premium finish — the polished look of a high-end coaching / SaaS launch ad. "Unreal Engine meets Hollywood production studio."

FORBIDDEN: a "VIP" badge or any membership tag; off-brand clothing colors (purple, etc.) carried over from the reference; pink, cyan, teal, or any non-gold accent hue; pure black #000000 backgrounds; cluttered layouts; tiny or garbled text; misspellings; stray logos; watermarks; extra brand marks; lorem-ipsum; more than one headline; left-aligned text.
